arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/test_budgets.py << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

def doc(cases, events, channels, definitions=None, timeout_ms=5, seed='s'):
    return {'seed': seed, 'definitions': definitions or [], 'timeout_ms': timeout_ms,
            'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'channels': channels}

def case(name, frames=None, **kw):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames or [],
            'expect': {'method': kw.get('method','GET'), 'target': kw.get('target','/a'), 'host': kw.get('host','h')}}

def hf(pairs, end=True):
    return {'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [[k, v] for k, v in pairs], 'End_Stream': end}

def chan(name, parts):
    return {'name': name, 'parts': [{'case': o, 'data': d} for o, d in parts]}

# ---- request budget: 20000 complete requests ok, 20001 -> input error ------
unit = "{{b'GET /a HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n' * 20000}}"
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [(None, unit)])]))
check('20000 requests ok', r['channels'][0]['error'] is None and len(r['channels'][0]['requests']) == 20000)
unit = "{{b'GET /a HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n' * 20001}}"
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [(None, unit)])]))
check('20001 requests -> input', r == {'error': 'input'}, str(r)[:80])

# ---- chunk-line budget: counting after CRLF check, before hex check -------
chunk_req = "POST /u HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"
ok = "{{b'1\\r\\nz\\r\\n' * 39999}}0\r\n\r\n"
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], method='POST', target='/u')],
                [], [chan('z', [(None, chunk_req + ok)])]))
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('40000 chunk lines ok', ch['error'] is None and ch['requests'][0]['body'] == fp(b'z'*39999),
      (ch['error'], ch['requests'][0]['body'] if ch['requests'] else None))

over = "{{b'1\\r\\nz\\r\\n' * 40000}}0\r\n\r\n"
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], method='POST', target='/u')],
                [], [chan('z', [(None, chunk_req + over)])]))
check('40001 chunk lines -> input', r == {'error': 'input'}, str(r)[:80])

# bad-hex complete line in chunk position is counted before the hex check
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], method='POST', target='/u')],
                [], [chan('z', [(None, chunk_req + "{{b'1\\r\\nz\\r\\n' * 40000}}zz\r\n")])]))
check('bad hex at 40001 -> budget first', r == {'error': 'input'}, str(r)[:80])
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], method='POST', target='/u')],
                [], [chan('z', [(None, chunk_req + "{{b'1\\r\\nz\\r\\n' * 39999}}zz\r\n")])]))
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('bad hex at 40000 -> syntax', ch['error'] == {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, ch['error'])

# unfinished line is not counted
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], method='POST', target='/u')],
                [], [chan('z', [(None, chunk_req + "{{b'1\\r\\nz\\r\\n' * 40000}}5")])]))
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('unfinished size line not counted', ch['error'] == {'kind': 'incomplete', 'offset': 0}, ch['error'])

# budget spans channels
half1 = "{{b'1\\r\\nz\\r\\n' * 20000}}"
half2 = "{{b'1\\r\\nz\\r\\n' * 20000}}0\r\n\r\n"
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], method='POST', target='/u')],
                [], [chan('z', [(None, chunk_req + half1)]), chan('y', [(None, chunk_req + half2)])]))
check('chunk budget spans channels', r == {'error': 'input'}, str(r)[:80])

# ---- huge compressed body must not be materialized -------------------------
huge_len = 1 << 40
hdr = "POST /u HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Length: " + str(huge_len) + "\r\n\r\n"
body = "{{b'A' * 1099511627776}}"
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], method='POST', target='/u')],
                [], [chan('z', [(None, hdr), (None, body)])]))
ch = r['channels'][0]
rec = ch['requests'][0]
# fingerprint of A * 2^40 computed independently via geometric series
def fp_pow(byte, n):
    h = 0
    k = 1
    base = (byte + 1)
    powr = 1            # 257^0
    # h = base * (257^(n-1) + ... + 1); compute sum iteratively in O(log n)
    def geom(n):        # sum_{i=0}^{n-1} 257^i mod 2^64
        if n == 0: return (0, 1)   # (sum, 257^n)
        if n % 2 == 0:
            s, p = geom(n // 2)
            return (s * (1 + p)) % (1 << 64), (p * p) % (1 << 64)
        s, p = geom(n - 1)
        return (s + p) % (1 << 64), (p * 257) % (1 << 64)
    s, _ = geom(n)
    return {'n': n, 'h': format(base * s % (1 << 64), '016x')}
check('huge body fp', rec['body'] == fp_pow(0x41, huge_len), rec['body'])
check('huge channel fp', ch['bytes']['n'] == len(hdr) + huge_len)
check('huge body framing', rec['framing'] == 'length' and ch['error'] is None)

# huge repeated channel of many requests from compressed data
many = "{{(b'GET /a HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h\\r\\n\\r\\n') * 100000}}"
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [(None, many)])]))
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('100000 requests parsed', ch['error'] is None and len(ch['requests']) == 100000 and ch['committed'] == [100000])

summary()
